name: Table
title: Table
summary: A data table for admin and report screens, with sortable headers, row selection, status badges, a row menu, zebra and dense variants, and a stacked-card layout on mobile.
whenToUse: Use for records people compare across columns: HD Radio stations, partner reports, NFC card orders, giving history.
Use the dense variant only in staff tools where many rows matter more than comfort.
whenNotToUse: Do not use for marketing content, single records (use DescriptionList) or fewer than about four rows (use a list).
Do not use a table for layout.

anatomy.description: Mobile cards (show under 768px, hide the table with `.dp-hide-mobile`, show cards with `.dp-show-mobile`):

props.name: getRowId
props.description: Stable unique id of a row.

props.name: getRowName
props.description: Human name of a row, used in checkbox and menu labels ("Radio Hope"). Required when `selectable` or `rowActions` is used.

props.name: 'aria-label'
props.description: Names the table's contents for assistive tech. Required (or give `caption`).

props.name: caption
props.description: Visible or hidden caption alternative to `aria-label`.

props.name: onSelectionChange
props.description: Called with the new selected ids.

props.name: onSortChange
props.description: Called when a sort header is pressed.

props.name: rowActions
props.description: Row menu items. Return an empty array for no menu on that row. Adds a ⋯ column.

props.name: footer
props.description: Footer content, for example the selection count ("1 of 38 stations selected") and pagination. Announced politely.

props.name: mobileCard
props.description: Render each row as a stacked card under 768px and hide the table there.

variantNotes: Default: 48px header on `--off-white`, 60px rows with `--gray-100` hairlines, panel radius `--radius-lg`.
`.dp-tbl-zebra`: even rows on `--off-white`. `.dp-tbl-sm`: 40px header, 44px rows, 14px text.
Add `.dp-tbl-clip` to the wrap when no row menu can overflow it.
Sorted column: `aria-sort` on the `th`; label turns black, arrow turns `--horizon-blue`. Unsorted columns show a grey up/down arrow.
Hover: row on `--off-white`. Selected: `aria-selected="true"`, row on `--blue-tint` with a 3px `--horizon-blue` left edge.
Row menu: ⋯ button `.dp-dots`; open state `aria-expanded="true"` with a `--gray-200` circle; menu `.dp-rmenu` uses `--shadow-overlay`, items 44px.
Mobile: `.dp-tcard` stacks name, meta, badge and the key figure; selected card gets a `--horizon-blue` border.

states.universal: See rules/states.md for the seven required states and their hooks.

rules: Use base `.badge` + `.badge-success/-info/-warning/-error` for status, always with a word. Add `.dp-dot` for a leading dot.
Right-align nothing except the action column; set numbers in `.dp-num` (tabular figures).
Put the row's main name in `.dp-strong` with the ID in `.dp-sub` beneath.
Menu items that leave the page end in ↗; destructive items use `.dp-rmenu-danger` and sit last, after `.dp-rmenu-sep`.
Keep one Horizon Blue primary per group; pagination uses `.btn-secondary .btn-sm`.
Every interactive control is at least 44px tall (`.dp-sort` and the mobile `.dp-dots` hit 44px; the table ⋯ is 40px plus a hit-area pad).
Do not colour whole rows by status.

accessibility: Use a real `<table>` with `<thead>`/`<th>`. Give the table a caption or an `aria-label` naming its contents.
Put the sort control in a `<button>` inside the `th`; set `aria-sort` on the `th` only for the sorted column.
Every checkbox and ⋯ button needs an `aria-label` naming the row ("Actions for Radio Hope").
The row menu uses `role="menu"` / `role="menuitem"`, opens on Enter/Space, closes on Escape and returns focus to ⋯.
Announce selection count in the footer ("1 of 38 stations selected").
content: Column labels are one or two words in sentence case: Station, City, Language, Frequency, Status.
Status words: On air, Scheduled, Maintenance, Offline. No codes on their own.
Mark invented figures as samples in mock-ups.
